name: Look up a member's name by member number
goal: Look up the member by member number and open their profile. Read back the member's full name as shown in the Name row of the profile table.

inputs.name: member_id
inputs.description: The member number to search for.

outputs.name: member_name
outputs.description: Full name shown on the member profile.

business_outcomes.description: The member number does not exist in the core system.

known_interstitials.description: Host-maintenance session notice that occasionally interrupts navigation.
